query: Best street food spots and street food markets in Hanoi

places.title: Dong Xuan Alley
places.text: Located right next to Dong Xuan Market, Dong Xuan Alley (Ngõ Đồng Xuân) is a legendary narrow lane dedicated entirely to local food. It is packed with tiny food stalls selling local Hanoi delicacies such as bun cha, bun oc (snail noodle soup), banh tom (shrimp cakes), and sweet che dessert soups at incredibly affordable prices.
places.address: Ng. Đồng Xuân, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Banh Mi 25
places.text: One of the most famous street food spots in the Hanoi Old Quarter, Banh Mi 25 offers a large menu of traditional and modern Vietnamese sandwiches with a simple seating area across the road. Known for crispy baguettes filled with flavorful pate, pork, chicken, or vegetarian options.
places.address: 25 P. Hàng Cá, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000, Vietnam

places.title: Ta Hien Beer Street
places.text: Known as the ultimate nightlife hub in the Old Quarter, Ta Hien Beer Street is packed with low plastic stools where locals and tourists gather. Along with cheap draught beer (bia hoi), the surrounding vendors serve popular street food snacks such as grilled pork skewers, fried cheese sticks, and lemongrass chicken feet.
places.opening_hours: Friday - Sunday: 7:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Most active during weekends)
places.address: 41-36 P. Lương Ngọc Quyến, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Hanoi Weekend Night Market Start Point
places.text: Beginning at Hang Dao Street, the Weekend Night Market is a bustling, pedestrian-only market that stretches across several blocks in the Old Quarter. While there are plenty of cheap souvenirs, the side alleys and food stalls offer a feast of grilled meats, tater tots, sausages, and traditional Vietnamese street snacks.
places.address: 104 P. Hàng Đào, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam
